ctx.x: Yeah, Drew (?). He wanted to leave the drummer, Raymond Howell. And he wanted to leave I think the other trombone player, Jap Allen...no, Jap Jones -- they wanted to leave him. And I think he wanted Leroy White, ...(?)... in Des Moines.
